title: Bahamas yacht trips with Eldridge Reeves Johnson

tellings.quote: They they they also went on these sort of trips to the Bahamas on this yacht owned by this guy Eldridge Reeves Johnson

plain: A circle of men that included William Stephenson and the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown went on trips to the Bahamas aboard a yacht owned by a man named Eldridge Reeves Johnson, according to Jesse Michels. Michels draws this from a book called A Man Called Intrepid. He brings it up as part of his case that the people behind the secrecy around UFOs were tied together in one tight, private network.
